label: copy phase: fed-back z when the next output is w (original bigram z w), from recall position 3 on
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always on steps where the fed-back input is z (97% of activation mass), and mainly when the token being output there is w, i.e. the original sequence had the bigram z w. It is strongest for recall_idx 3-4. It is weak or silent at recall_idx 0-2, and weaker when the z w is the last thing left to copy. The largest activations come when w is also the next output after that (z w w). Weak activations also show up on copy-phase z followed by other tokens, and on fed-back w just before another w. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Dev: P 0.86, R 0.59, F1 0.70, mass recall 0.80.
